title: Introduction to Exact Penalization for Mathematical Programming with Equilibrium Constraints
summary: We present a focused introduction to exact penalty methods for nonlinear programs and mathematical programs with equilibrium constraints (MPECs), emphasizing their connection to modern error bound theory. The goal is twofold. First, we explain how classical optimality conditions can be interpreted through exact penalization, and why such results typically rely on constraint regularity conditions that can be understood as error bounds on perturbations of feasible sets.
